final_message: I cleaned the data by removing duplicate events, keeping only the first event per order id (3 duplicates removed). I normalized category names by trimming spaces and converting to lowercase. I converted totals from strings with commas to floats and excluded orders with total -1 from revenue but counted them as missing totals (11 such orders). I parsed timestamps to UTC to correctly identify orders placed in March 2024 for the revenue and order count. The category with the highest total revenue overall is "garden". The results are saved in workspace/answer.json.
